cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

confusable: D160 gets B admission before revealing depth; D136 offers own truth first as bait.
comparison: Autonomous chair shadow versus waving noodle.
